additional_info.body:
Dear Daniel,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / S8 313835473001
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
KfGO66
Problem Description
: Converter Error : E52
Troubleshooting
:
We have analyzed the charger and identified a problem with the fast shutdown wiring. We need to schedule a site intervention to check the following:
Since the converter error E:52 is user-generated and indicates a failure in the fast shutdown check, we should examine the wiring. If possible, please bring a spare KF13 with you.
Check the connection on the +F03-XD6 terminal.
Check the connections on XD9.2A/B and XD14.1A/B.
Check the connections on +F03 XD5 for the 12VDC supply.
Check the connection on Switching MG1-MG2.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0386765 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
AT
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :

We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
